### CALL TO TENDER SAO PAULO - GUARULHOS AIRPORT IN ACCORDANCE TO THE SLOTS’ EXCHANGE PROCEDURE


08/28/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/986550758/files/doc_news/2026/Aug/28/Call-to-tender-sep26_english.pdf)
- [Procedimiento Slots (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/986550758/files/doc_news/2026/Aug/28/attachments/Procedimiento-Slots.pdf)
- [Anexo 5 (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/986550758/files/doc_news/2026/Aug/28/attachments/Anexo-5.pdf)
- [Anexo 5A (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/986550758/files/doc_news/2026/Aug/28/attachments/Anexo-5A.pdf)


In compliance to the ruling of the *Tribunal de Defensa de la Libre Competencia* (Competition Court of Chile), and to the provisions contained in the document “LATAM Slots’ Exchange Procedure According to the First Condition Resolution No. 37/2011 HTDLC” approved by the *Tribunal de Defensa de la Libre Competencia* of Chile (hereinafter referred to as the “Procedure”); LATAM Airlines Group S.A. informs the beginning of the tender procedure regulated by the Procedure and further informs the following:


1. The closing date for filing proposals expires at 12:00am of the 22th of September 2026.


1. The Notary where the instruments established by the Procedure will be executed is the Santiago’s Notary of **Magdalena Latorre.**


1. The following is the calendar of activities published by the *Comitê de Facilitação de Voos* (Flights Facilitating Committee) of the International Airport Sao Paulo- Guarulhos, Governor André Franco Montoro; for the following IATA season:


COMITÊ DE FACILITAÇÃO DE VOOS


Calendar of Activities


Activity Summer 2027 (S27)


Statement of capacity 07/09/2026


SHL Deadline 14/09/2026


Agreed Historics Deadline 01/10/2026


Initial Submission Deadline 08/10/2026


SAL Deadline 05/11/2026


IATA Slot Conference 17/11/2026 a 19/11/2026


Slot Return Deadline 15/12/2026


National Slots Conference 20/01/2027 a 22/01/2027


Historics Baseline Date 31/01/2027


Start/End of Season 28/03/2027 a 30/10/2027


Additionally, we inform that a PEI (special exchange procedure- regulated by Article 28 of the Procedure) may be initiated provided the following conditions are met: (i) that LATAM has not exchanged to the date four daily takeoff Slots or four daily landing Slots; and (ii) that no Tender is in process, according to the regulations established in the Procedure.


For further information, please contact LATAM:


Webpage:[ir.latam.com](https://ir.latam.com/)
